protocol.name: PBGA-P0
protocol.split: train loaded with deterministic val transforms
protocol.bn_policy: train-mode batch statistics; running buffers restored exactly after each batch

verdict.rule: GO iff at least one scale has total-gradient negative-dot rate >=0.10 and median ||g_o2o||/||g_o2m|| >=0.05 at two or more checkpoints.
verdict.note: With eight batches, a nonzero conflict rate has 0.125 granularity.
